summary.description: One or two sentences on the change and what you found.

findings.description: Zero findings is a valid review.

line_start.description: First line of the problem in that file.

line_end.description: Last line of the problem. Same as line_start for one line.

severity.description: bug: a named input gives a wrong result. risk: could go wrong but no failing input shown.

claim.description: One sentence saying what is wrong.

evidence.description: The code, the input or state, and the wrong result.
